page.layout: Two-column-free single page of running text. Running head at top centre-left, page number at top right. Main text block in the centre; right margin holds notes ("Greg.l.4.epist.36 initio.", "Sirmundus Iof.", "quæ supra pag.63.", "Supra cap.2.", "SECT. X.", and a "+" mark). Below the text: a centred source line, a block quotation from Bellarminus, a centred heading with a subtitle, then the body paragraph, which runs on to the foot. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: aut pateris : quasi vero Regem aut Monarcham vllum ita excordem esse vel mente fingere quis possit, qui Regis nomen Nouum, sacrilegium, à Prædecessoribus suis nun-quàm vsurpatum, in se abominandum, sibique abrogandum, in animum inducat suum; vt hoc pacto facilius coerceat perduelles, & maiestatis reos, titulum istum falsò sibi vsurpantes. Quid quòd multo animosior fuerit Gregorius, quàm vt de dignitate suâ vel tantillum decerpi pateretur: Nam {x}Humilitatem (inquit) teneamus in mente, ita tamen vt ordinis nostri dignitatem seruemus in honore. Greg.l.4.epist.36 initio. Apagite igitur cum istis titulis inanibus Romani Episcopi, & Romanæ Diœceseos Vniuersalis, quos penè vniuersorum ordinum censuræ penitùs expunxerunt. Priusquàm ad ea, quæ sequuntur, progredi liceat, quæsitu indignum (mi Sirmonde) non videtur, quomodo Papa, [illegible, ~2 letters]ecialis Patriarcha Occidentis, passus sit{y} Auelli à Diœcesi Romana (id enim Te male habet) iamq; throno Constantinopolitano subiici Metropolitanus Prouinciæ, videlicet, Thessalonicensem, Corinthiam, Nicopolitanam, Atheniensem, Patrensem: siquidem Ille, vt totius orbis spiritualis & vniuersalis Monarchæ, Eas suo sibi iure, inuitis omnibus, retinere potuerat? Tu nunc perge Bellarmine.
“Debent Pontifices Verbo, & epistolis non tacere vitia Principum; sed, vt Apostolus loquitur, arguere, obsecrare, increpare opportunè, importunè, omni patientiâ, & doctrinâ.” --- Pag.34. +
main_text.head: I. ANIMADVERSIO. Pontifices nihil minùs quàm docendo Monitores agere.
main_text.p: SECT. X.Debent Pontifices (quis enim negat?) Principum vitia verbo arguere. sed huius muneris functionem nihil pensi habent, nam iamdiu {*}Verbum prædicare defierunt. Supra cap.2. Debent etiam Epistolis eos increpare: nemo in-

page.notes: Printed "Y" at the foot left is the gathering signature; "ficias:" at the right is the catchword, so the text ends at "in-". The word after "Papa," is hidden by a smudge; only "ecialis" is legible, so the lost letters are marked. The "+" in the right margin beside the Bellarmine quotation is a printed mark; its meaning is unclear. The reference marks x, y and * are read from the printed superscripts; the Sirmundus note's mark is uncertain. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout (e.g. "Thessalonicensem" as Thessalonicensem). Running head and page number are as printed.
